data.intent: Knowledge-intake front door for Ulti-pedia: mobile-first structured form (v1) evolving into an AI-guided coverage-aware interview with voice + seed KB (v2), all writing one versioned envelope to Supabase via a FastAPI backend.

Blocking foundation: versioned submission envelope schema, Supabase submissions+form_events tables, FastAPI skeleton, server-side validation/anti-troll, POST /api/submissions and /api/events. The contract every other partition depends on.

Mobile-first React form: tutorial->path-select->type sections (Drills/Strategies/Other), optional fields + freeform, tap tooltips, localStorage autosave + save + retry queue, contributor+consent+prefill, confirm->thank-you->submit-another. Posts to the Foundation submission API.

Seed KB + canonical entity registry: rights-clean seed corpus to the envelope schema, entities/entity_coverage/kb_chunks tables + pgvector, embedding pipeline, entities.py (semantic resolve -> confirm-then-resolve) and coverage.py (per-aspect gaps/record). Grounds the v2 interview.

Polish + analytics for the v1 form: Framer Motion section transitions + tutorial->info-bar shrink, warm per-section palette with AA contrast + prefers-reduced-motion, learn-more documentation page, analytics wiring (Plausible/Umami) + field_completed funnel event.
